newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Infratil Int. invests US$17 mln in U.S. airport co.
newsitem.headline: Infratil Int. invests US$17 mln in U.S. airport co.

text.p: Infratil International said on Thursday it would invest US$17 million in U.S. Pasadena-based airport investor Airport Group International (AGI) for an 11.8 percent interest in the company.

Infratil said it planned to invest through forming alliances with international infrastructure operators or organisations that had international infrastructure consultancies; or investing directly in overseas utility companies and projects.
The issue had been underwritten to 50 million shares, or NZ$25 million, and it was expected that the timing of the offer would be announced prior to the end of the month.
Infratil International is managed by New Zealand-based merchant bankers Morrison & Co, who also manage Infratil NZ Ltd and are specialist advisers to the infrastructure and utilities sector.
